entry.title: How I grab 20+ cheap tickets to Broadway shows

link.title: How I grab 20+ cheap tickets to Broadway shows

entry.content:
I have seen 20+ Broadway shows, and I got most of the tickets cheaply through lotteries, rush, and quick-sell discounts. Here is where I look; I will add more detail later.

  • Telecharge (lottery): telecharge.com
  • Lucky Seat (lottery): luckyseat.com
  • Broadway Direct (lottery): broadwaydirect.com
  • TodayTix (rush and lottery): todaytix.com
  • Hamilton app (lottery): the in-app lottery for Hamilton
  • Theatre app (quick-sell discount): turn on notifications so you can buy tickets ahead of others

More detail coming soon.
entry.summary: The lotteries, rush and discount apps I use to see Broadway shows cheaply (a work in progress).
